mods.description: A visuals-first utility client. Pretty above all else. Only meant for singleplayer or anarchy server use. No anticheat bypass.

releases.notes:
**Unlucky Client 2.6** — MC 26.3 / Fabric. 208 modules.

**Combat**
- Added BedAura — places beds against a target and sets them off wherever beds explode. It reads the bed rule at the bed's own position, so datapack dimensions work too, and it waits for AnchorAura in the End so the two don't fight over the hotbar.
- Added AutoCity — mines one block of a target's surround, preferring the side that opens a crystal spot at their feet.
- Added SelfTrap — covers your head (Top), your head ring (Face) or your whole hole (Full), so nothing lands a crystal or an anchor on top of you.
- Added AutoWeb — drops cobwebs right where the target is standing.
- Added ShieldBreaker — knocks a raised shield down with one quick axe hit the moment it points at you, then hands your weapon back.
- Added AutoWeapon — puts the best weapon in hand at the moment of a hit, whoever made it: your own clicks, Aura or anything else. The slot reaches the server together with the hit.
- Added Quiver — shoots tipped arrows straight up so Strength and Speed come down on you. BowAimbot leaves those shots alone.
- Surround and AutoTrap have a new Custom shape, drawn block by block in a 3D pattern editor with presets and layers.
- Aura, MaceCombo and AutoXPRepair now share the hotbar instead of swapping items back under each other.

**Player**
- Added NoMissDelay — removes vanilla's half-second attack lockout after a swing at nothing.
- Added MiddleClickAction — middle-click throws a pearl, rocket, wind charge or XP bottle from the hotbar without switching to it. Middle-clicking a player still adds a friend.
- Added AutoOminousBottle — drinks an ominous bottle whenever Bad Omen runs out, for raid and trial farms.
- AutoXPRepair goes through the offhand manager, so AutoTotem always wins the offhand, and during an Aura fight it gives the sword back.
- Capes has a live preview of the selected cape on your skin.

**Movement**
- Added Timer — runs the game faster or slower than 20 ticks a second.

**World**
- Added ChestManager — a searchable record of your base's chests. `.cm add` tags a chest, `.cm click` tags everything you right-click, and `.cm search <item>` makes every chest holding the item glow, shulkers and bundles inside them included, with the count above it and the slot outlined once you open it. Scanning happens without a window ever opening on your screen. The ClickGUI has a Chests tab with a 3D view of your tagged chests.
- Added Excavator — digs out the box between `.excavate pos1` and `pos2`, top down, one layer at a time.
- Added HighwayBuilder — digs and paves a straight highway in any of the eight directions. It never walks onto a floor that isn't paved yet, and it stops with a reason when it runs out of blocks or pickaxes, or reaches lava or bedrock.
- Excavator, HighwayBuilder and Printer can show their work area in 3D, with finished and remaining blocks and how far along the job is.

**Render**
- Added AntiInvis — draws invisible entities see-through, like an invisible teammate.
- Added FocusFps — caps the frame rate while the game window isn't focused.

**HUD**
- Added the CrystalMap widget — the crystal target's model, health and armour, above a map of every spot a crystal could go around them, coloured by how much it hurts them compared with you. The map can be 3D or flat from the top, and players on it are drawn as their heads.
- The Radar draws the terrain from above like a vanilla map, and players as their heads. Both can be turned off.
- PlayerModel shows flying, swimming and crawling the way the inventory does: the body lies flat, the wings spread, and the box turns sideways to fit it without zooming in.

**Misc**
- Added Notifier — toasts for players entering or leaving visual range, totem pops and armour wearing thin.

releases.notes:
**Unlucky Client 2.5** — MC 26.3 / Fabric. 191 modules.

**Combat**
- Added ElytraMace — you fly and aim the dive; it swaps the elytra for a chestplate on the last tick that still reaches, lands a real mace smash once the server has ended the glide, then puts the elytra back on, glides again and fires a rocket once the way ahead is clear. It only commits to a dive whose miss you would survive or that a re-glide or a wind charge under your feet can catch. The Inventory chestplate source keeps the critical hit; Offhand and Hotbar swap by right-click, which resets the attack charge on 26.3 servers, so their smash lands without the crit.
- Fixed module attacks swinging only on your screen. 26.3 no longer sends a swing with the arm, so Aura, TriggerBot, CrystalAura, AnchorAura, MaceCombo, AutoClicker, Criticals and Surround now send it with the hit, like a real click, and use the weapon's own attack swing.

**Player**
- Fixed AutoEat getting stuck on food it could not eat. With a full hunger bar it now only reaches for food you can eat anyway, such as golden apples, instead of holding right-click on a steak forever.
- Fixed AntiAFK's swing not counting as activity on 26.3 servers; it now sends the swing the server's idle timer listens for.
- Fixed GhostHand ignoring the new straw beds.

**World**
- Fixed Nuker, SpeedMine and VeinMiner breaking without a visible swing for other players.
- Fixed the Packet swing mode of Scaffold, Surround, HoleFill, AutoTrap, Burrow, LiquidFiller and SpawnProofer sending an attack swing on 26.3, which reset your attack charge on every block. The server now shows placement swings to others by itself, so Packet places without one.

**ClickGUI**
- Fixed typing on 26.3. No letter reached the ClickGUI search in either style, the block, item and brew pickers, text settings, Configs, Console, Friends or the HUD editor's text fields; backspace and the arrows worked, which is why it looked half-broken. 26.3 only delivers typed characters to screens that ask for them, and ours now do.
- Fixed the config Import/Export and skin file pickers: the file-type filter could come up garbled and the window had no title.

**Render**
- Fixed RainbowEnchant colouring the whole item instead of its glint. 26.3 draws the glint inside the item itself, so the tint now goes on the glint texture: the item keeps its own colours and the glint takes yours, at vanilla's strength in every hue. Hide glint and Opacity work as before.

**Chat**
- Fixed `.bind` with number keys: every digit but 0 bound an unrelated key, such as Enter or Escape.
- Fixed binds on numpad divide, minus and period from older configs; they now carry over instead of being cleared.

releases.notes:
**Unlucky Client 2.4.1** — MC 26.3 / Fabric. 190 modules.

**Fixes**
- Fixed mouse buttons in the ClickGUI and every other client screen on 26.3. Left click was running right-click actions and right click did nothing, because 26.3 renumbered the mouse buttons along with the keys. Toggling modules, expanding settings, dragging panels, the pickers and the HUD editor's widget menu now respond to the correct button.
- Fixed setting keybinds in the ClickGUI. The bind row was waiting for a left click that 26.3 no longer reported as one. Binds you already had kept working; only setting new ones was broken.

releases.notes:
**Unlucky Client 2.4** — MC 26.3 / Fabric. 190 modules.

**Client**
- Updated to Minecraft 26.3. Players staying on 26.2 keep 2.3.1, which continues on its own branch.
- Keybinds carry over: 26.3 renumbered every key, so the first launch converts binds saved by earlier versions once — the main config and every profile you load or import. Binds on numpad `/` and `-` have no 26.3 equivalent and come back unbound instead of silently landing on another key.
- Config import/export and the skin picker use the system file dialog through the game's new window layer, and no longer hold a thread open while it is up.

**Combat**
- Fixed Criticals' Packet mode on 26.3: the hop now goes up in one tick and down in the next, with the hit right behind it, so it lands one tick later than before — and actually crits. 26.3 servers accept one position per tick, and the old same-tick hop only ever reached them halfway.
- Fixed LegitMaceKill and BlatantMaceKill the same way: climb, then fall and hit, then land, one tick each. If the target is gone before the hit can go out, the spoof steps back down in short drops instead of landing the whole height as fall damage.
- Swings use the held item's own animation, so a spear stabs instead of whacking when a module attacks with it.

**Movement**
- 26.3 servers disconnect a client that sends more than one position in a tick. The client now enforces that limit itself, so no module combination can get you kicked with "invalid player movement".
- Blink releases its queue one position per tick instead of all at once — the server replays your path rather than receiving it in one burst.
- EventlessFly no longer sends its out-of-bounds packet, which 26.3 servers would kick for; it flies on its own positions alone.

**Player**
- InfiniteInteract reaches one packet step past vanilla — up to about 12 blocks with the maximum step — instead of walking a long path, which 26.3 servers no longer accept in one tick. It stays in place while you keep breaking or attacking and steps back once you stop. Maximum steps and Maximum range are gone.
- Capes adds Hero and Twisted, the Minecraft Dungeons II promo capes.
- Capes now carries all fourteen MineCon 2011 vote capes. The three it listed as Votes 3–5 were other revisions of Votes 7, 12 and 13, and are named that way now. Numbered capes sort in order — Vote 2 before Vote 10.
- AutoBrew plans from the game's built-in brewing recipes. 26.3 no longer sends brewing recipes to the client, so a server's custom brews cannot be planned.

**Render**
- RainbowEnchant now colours every glint variant 26.3 draws, including the special item and armour variants the old check missed.

releases.notes:
**Unlucky Client 2.3.1** — MC 26.2 / Fabric. 190 modules.

**Render**
- Added Tracers — a standalone module for players, hostile and passive mobs, items, vehicles, projectiles and other loaded entities. Includes friend handling, per-mob filters, range and line-of-sight controls, configurable screen and body anchors, optional stems, and type, distance, static or theme colours.

**World**
- Printer now separates **Print only** from **Automatic fly**. Print only is the new default and places schematic blocks already in reach without moving the player, changing Litematica layers, surveying stashes or handling shulker supplies. Switching modes live releases every automation-owned state cleanly; existing Printer configs remain compatible.

**Movement**
- Added `.vclip up <blocks>` and `.vclip down <blocks>`, plus signed shorthand such as `.vclip -3`, for short vertical clips. Invalid, mounted and over-10-block moves are rejected instead of creating a one-frame client/server desync.

**Player**
- Reworked AutoEat to use the selected food directly instead of holding the shared right-click key. It can now eat while an inventory or container is open without closing the screen, opening the block under the crosshair, placing a held block or shuffling the main hand out of the offhand's way. Interrupted meals retry once and then yield cleanly.

**Fixes**
- Fixed the brief freeze some players saw when opening containers. InventoryInfo's optional byte-size line no longer serializes a component-heavy hovered item on the render thread: work is asynchronous, bounded to one active and one latest request, and stale results are discarded. Byte size now defaults off.
- InventoryInfo's ender-chest preview now recopies slots only when the menu revision or contents actually change, removing unnecessary per-tick stack copies while the screen is open.
- Fixed the first-run Offhand migration accepting only legacy primitive settings. Bundled defaults and older profiles now both load through the canonical setting format.
